functionalReqs: Special moves: castling, en passant, promotion
hints: Each piece knows how it moves. Polymorphism over a big switch.
A move is an object you can store, replay and undo.

Board of Cells; abstract Piece with canMove(board, from, to) overridden per type; Move (Command) with execute/undo stored in history; Game checks for king safety after each candidate move; GameStatus enum; Player with colour; optional Clock.
nonFunctionalReqs: Move validation logic for each piece is isolated
Easy to add timers or online play later
problemStatement: Design a **two-player chess** game: validate moves for each piece type, detect check, checkmate and stalemate, and keep a move history.
title: Design Chess
